stem: On 29 September a Voltmarkt store has 30 gaming headsets on hand. In the 28 days before, the headset closed with stock on 20 days and sold 50 units on those days. On the other 8 days the shelf was empty and nothing sold. Using Voltmarkt's convention, where the average weekly units come from in-stock days only, how many weeks of cover does the store have? Give weeks with 1 decimal.
